entries.author: EUTHYMIUS ZIGABENUS
entries.title: Editorum Patrologiae Monitum
entries.note: OCR page numbers before 11 are lost (first running head, '11/12 PROLEGOMENA', at line 362; 13/14 at 449), so 9 is by sequence: Monitum and Fabricius notitia fill the page 9/10 before that header. Ordo lists Monitum without a column. 'Editorum Patrologiae Monitum' also signed J.-B. M.

entries.author: EUTHYMIUS ZIGABENUS

entries.note: Head 'DE EUTHYMIO ZIGABENO / Ex Bibliotheca Graeca Joannis Alberti Fabricii' at line 285, same page run as the Monitum (9/10 into 11/12; Ordo lists it under Prolegomena).

entries.author: EUTHYMIUS ZIGABENUS
entries.title: Nicolai Fogginii Proemium
entries.note: Header '21 PROLEGOMENA 22' at line 897; head 'JOANNI CHRISTOPIORO AMADUTIO NICOLAUS FOGGINIUS S. D.' at line 993 before the 23/24 header (line 1014). Elenchus calls it Proemium; Ordo calls it 'Notitia alia ex Nicol. Fogginio'.

entries.author: EUTHYMIUS ZIGABENUS
entries.title: Antonii Bongiovanni Praefatio ad Euthymii Commentaria in Psalmos, editioni principi Graeco-Latinae praemissa, Venetiis 1758-63, cum Theophylacti Operibus
entries.note: Header '35 PROLEGOMENA 36' at line 1847 (OCR '45 ... 36'); head 'ANT. BONGIOVANNI PRAEFATIO' at line 1876. (Elenchus prints the date as 1158-63, an OCR misread of 1758-63; not bodied.)

entries.author: EUTHYMIUS ZIGABENUS
entries.title: Euthymii Commentarius in Psalmos Davidis
entries.note: Elenchus gives the range 41-1326. Greek head 'EUTHYMIOU MONACHOU TOU ZIGABENOU EXEGESIS EIS TO PSALTERION' at line 2040, Latin head 2050-2059 (interprete Philippo Saulo), Prooemium 2065. No page number prints at the head (first page of a work carries no running head; the signature mark at 2153 and '43' at 2163 bound it), so 41 is by sequence. End: Psalmus CL at line 105912 and header '1325/1326 COMMENT. IN PSALMOS' (OCR '1395 ... 1326') at line 106000, then the Ordo.

problems: Whole volume is one author; Elenchus lists 6 items and the body matches. Numbers for the first 8 pages (Monitum/Fabricius) and the commentary head are by page sequence because the OCR dropped those page numbers.
Elenchus prints Bongiovanni's date as 1158-63 (OCR); Ordo carries no columns for this volume.
